# Launch Overseas Limited (領海品牌管理有限公司)
> Global Brand Management & Multi-Market Distribution Consultancy operating from Hong Kong SAR.
> Aligned with international GoGlobal trade standards and multi-market professional services.

## Organization Summary
- Legal Entity: Launch Overseas Limited (領海品牌管理有限公司)
- Jurisdiction: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
- Primary Scope: Strategic market entry advisory, testing & certification (US FDA / EU CPNP), omnichannel retail door distribution, localized PR campaigns, and cross-border tax/legal governance.
- Target Expansion Territories: North America (US, Canada), Europe (UK, EU), East Asia (Japan, South Korea), Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam).

## Core Capabilities (HKTDC GoGlobal Aligned)
1. Strategic Consulting & Market Incubation: Whitespace audits, product localization, and market-entry roadmaps.
2. Retail Distribution & Digital Channel Operations: D2C stores, Amazon operations, and offline retail door pitching.
3. Integrated Marketing & Brand PR: Tier-1 international PR features, localized creator campaigns, pop-up events.
4. Testing, Certification, Logistics & Regulatory Compliance: US FDA / EU CPNP testing, free-port logistics staging, and international IP/tax structuring.

## Target Enterprise Profiles
- Profile A: High-growth consumer brands seeking turnkey overseas delegation.
- Profile B: Cross-border e-commerce & supply chain enterprises expanding to offline retail.
- Profile C: Established retail brands requiring licensing and structured regional distribution.
